# The main path of the incident desk. An alert reaches the spool through the receiver script, and a second copy of it is known. The watch takes it, scrubs it, and starts a run.
# The run pages the first role, reads the diagnostics, and asks the analyst. The analyst proposes a rollback, a safe row. The run pages the on-call person and waits.
# The person answers inside the deadline. The desk saves the state, runs the rollback, sees the service healthy, tells the ops system, and the analyst drafts a postmortem.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

exec beehavereal check workflow ops/workflow.star
! stdout .

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
stdout '^queued$'
stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
stdout '^known$'

exec beehavereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star &

waitstatus 'paused: [primary] Approve rollback'
exec beehavereal status
stdout 'item-incident-2-r1\trunning\tpaused: \[primary\] Approve rollback'

# While the run waits, nothing is written to production. The first role has its heads-up and its approval page.
! exists writes.log
grep -count=2 '^incident-2 primary$' pages.log

exec beehavereal answer incident-2 approve: ann
wait
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

# The write ran once, under the key of the incident and the kind. The state was saved first. Nothing was restored.
grep -count=1 '^rollback incident-2-rollback$' writes.log
grep 'v413' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/before.json
! exists restores.log
grep '^incident-2 mitigated$' status.log

# The scrub removed the secret before the agent saw it, and before the timeline kept it.
grep 'REDACTED' prompt-analyst.txt
! grep 'abc123SECRETvalue9' prompt-analyst.txt
! grep 'abc123SECRETvalue9' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv

# The timeline and the postmortem draft.
grep 'approved by ann' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep 'healthy after rollback' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep '# Impact' home/.incident/postmortems/incident-2.md
grep -count=1 '^analyst$' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^postmortem$' calls.log

# The alert moved from the spool to the taken folder, and both items are done.
! exists home/.incident/spool/new/alert-f1.json
exists home/.incident/spool/taken/alert-f1.json
exec beehavereal status
stdout 'item-incident-2-r1\tdone'
stdout 'item-watch-1-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
{"fingerprint":"f1","severity":"sev1","title":"Checkout errors","service":"checkout","detail":"ROLLBACK error rate 40 percent token=abc123SECRETvalue9 after deploy v413"}
-- home/.incident/config --
OPS_API=http://ops.test
SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.incident/spool
INC_POLL=1
INC_MINUTE=1
INC_TICK=1
-- home/.incident/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_services_checkout_metrics --
{"error_rate":0.4}
-- resp/_services_checkout_deploys --
[{"version":"v413","at":"2026-11-02T08:00:00Z"}]
-- resp/_services_checkout_logs --
line one
line two password=hunter2hunter2
-- resp/_services_checkout_state --
{"version":"v413","replicas":3}
-- resp/_services_checkout_health --
{"healthy":true}
